meals.name: Fluffy Pancakes
meals.description: Light and fluffy American-style pancakes with a golden exterior and soft interior. Perfect for a weekend breakfast with maple syrup and fresh berries.
steps: Mix flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt in a large bowl
Whisk together milk, melted butter, egg, and vanilla in another bowl
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and mix until just combined (lumps are okay)
Heat a griddle or non-stick pan over medium heat
Pour ¼ cup batter for each pancake
Cook until bubbles form on surface, then flip and cook until golden
Serve hot with maple syrup and fresh berries

meals.name: Spaghetti Carbonara
meals.description: Classic Italian pasta dish with crispy pancetta, eggs, Parmesan cheese, and black pepper. Creamy without using cream - authentic Roman style.
steps: Bring large pot of salted water to boil and cook spaghetti al dente
While pasta cooks, fry pancetta in a large pan until crispy
Add garlic to pancetta and cook for 1 minute
Whisk eggs and Parmesan together in a bowl with plenty of black pepper
Drain pasta, reserving 1 cup of pasta water
Remove pan from heat, add hot pasta to pancetta
Quickly mix in egg mixture, tossing constantly (heat from pasta will cook eggs)
Add pasta water gradually until creamy consistency
Serve immediately with extra Parmesan and black pepper

meals.name: Buddha Bowl
meals.description: Nourishing vegetarian bowl packed with quinoa, roasted vegetables, chickpeas, avocado, and tahini dressing. Colorful, healthy, and satisfying.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C)
Cook quinoa according to package directions
Toss sweet potato and chickpeas with olive oil, cumin, salt, and pepper
Roast for 25 minutes, adding broccoli for last 10 minutes
Massage kale with a little olive oil and lemon juice
Mix tahini with lemon juice and water to make dressing
Assemble bowls with quinoa, roasted vegetables, kale, and avocado
Drizzle with tahini dressing and serve

meals.name: Chicken Pad Thai
meals.description: Thailand's famous street food noodle dish with chicken, rice noodles, eggs, peanuts, and tamarind sauce. Sweet, sour, and savory in perfect harmony.
steps: Soak rice noodles in warm water for 20 minutes, then drain
Mix tamarind paste, fish sauce, and brown sugar for sauce
Heat oil in wok or large pan over high heat
Stir-fry chicken until cooked through, remove and set aside
Add more oil, scramble eggs, then push to side
Add garlic, then noodles and sauce, toss for 2 minutes
Add chicken back, plus half the peanuts, bean sprouts, and green onions
Toss everything together for 1 minute
Serve topped with remaining peanuts, bean sprouts, and lime wedges

meals.name: Chocolate Lava Cake
meals.description: Decadent individual chocolate cakes with a molten chocolate center. Impressive dessert that's surprisingly easy to make.
ingredients: Butter and cocoa powder for ramekins
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C)
Butter four 6oz ramekins and dust with cocoa powder
Melt chocolate and butter together in microwave or double boiler
Whisk eggs, egg yolks, and sugar until thick and pale
Fold melted chocolate into egg mixture
Gently fold in flour and salt
Divide batter among ramekins
Bake for 12-14 minutes until edges are firm but center jiggles slightly
Let rest 1 minute, then invert onto plates
Serve immediately with vanilla ice cream

meals.name: Vegetable Curry
meals.description: Aromatic Indian curry loaded with vegetables in a creamy coconut tomato sauce. Warming spices and rich flavors make this a comfort food favorite.
steps: Heat coconut oil in large pot over medium heat
Sauté onion until soft, about 5 minutes
Add garlic, ginger, curry powder, and turmeric, cook 1 minute
Add coconut milk and tomatoes, bring to simmer
Add cauliflower and potatoes, simmer 15 minutes
Add chickpeas and cook until vegetables are tender
Stir in spinach until wilted
Season with salt and garnish with cilantro
Serve with rice or naan bread

meals.name: Avocado Toast Deluxe
meals.description: Elevated avocado toast with poached eggs, cherry tomatoes, feta cheese, and microgreens. A trendy brunch classic done right.
steps: Toast sourdough bread until golden and crispy
Bring pot of water to gentle simmer for poaching eggs
Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper
Crack eggs into simmering water and poach for 3-4 minutes
Spread avocado generously on toast
Top with cherry tomatoes and feta cheese
Place poached egg on top
Garnish with microgreens, red pepper flakes, and drizzle of olive oil
Serve immediately

meals.name: Chicken Fried Rice
meals.description: Quick Asian takeout favorite made at home with chicken, vegetables, eggs, and day-old rice. Better than delivery and ready in 15 minutes.
steps: Heat oil in large wok or skillet over high heat
Cook chicken until browned and cooked through, remove and set aside
Scramble eggs in same pan, break into small pieces, remove
Add more oil, stir-fry garlic and ginger for 30 seconds
Add mixed vegetables, cook 2 minutes
Add rice, breaking up any clumps
Add chicken and eggs back to pan
Pour in soy sauce and sesame oil, toss everything together
Cook 2-3 minutes until rice is heated through and slightly crispy
Top with green onions and serve hot

meals.name: Margherita Pizza
meals.description: Classic Neapolitan pizza with fresh mozzarella, basil, and tomato sauce on a crispy homemade crust. Simple ingredients, extraordinary flavor.
steps: Mix flour, yeast, sugar, and salt in large bowl
Add olive oil and warm water, knead for 8-10 minutes until smooth
Let dough rise in oiled bowl for 1 hour until doubled
Preheat oven to 475°F (245°C) with pizza stone if available
Divide dough in half, roll each into 12-inch circle
Spread tomato sauce leaving 1-inch border
Arrange mozzarella slices evenly
Bake 10-12 minutes until crust is golden and cheese bubbles
Top with fresh basil and drizzle with olive oil
Slice and serve immediately

meals.name: Tiramisu
meals.description: Italian no-bake dessert with coffee-soaked ladyfingers layered with mascarpone cream and cocoa. Make ahead for an elegant dinner party finale.
steps: Whisk egg yolks and sugar in double boiler until thick and pale
Remove from heat, let cool slightly
Beat mascarpone until smooth, fold into egg mixture
Whip heavy cream to stiff peaks, fold into mascarpone mixture
Mix espresso with coffee liqueur in shallow dish
Quickly dip ladyfingers in coffee mixture (don't soak)
Layer half the ladyfingers in 9x13 dish
Spread half the mascarpone cream over ladyfingers
Repeat layers with remaining ingredients
Refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight
Dust with cocoa powder and chocolate shavings before serving

meals.name: Beef Tacos
meals.description: Flavorful ground beef tacos with homemade seasoning, fresh toppings, and warm tortillas. Quick weeknight dinner the whole family loves.
steps: Brown ground beef in large skillet over medium-high heat
Add onion and garlic, cook until softened
Drain excess fat
Add chili powder, cumin, paprika, and water
Simmer 5-7 minutes until sauce thickens
Warm taco shells or tortillas
Fill with beef mixture
Top with lettuce, tomatoes, cheese, sour cream, and salsa
Serve immediately with lime wedges

meals.name: Vegetable Ramen
meals.description: Homemade ramen with rich miso broth, fresh vegetables, soft-boiled eggs, and ramen noodles. Comfort food that warms the soul.
steps: Bring small pot of water to boil for eggs
Boil eggs for 6-7 minutes, then ice bath and peel
Heat sesame oil in large pot, sauté garlic and ginger
Add vegetable broth and bring to simmer
Whisk in miso paste and soy sauce
Add mushrooms and cook 5 minutes
Cook ramen noodles according to package
Blanch bok choy in boiling water for 2 minutes
Divide noodles among bowls, ladle broth over
Top with halved eggs, bok choy, corn, green onions, and sesame seeds
